'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Mike Kessler LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Kessler]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Transcription note: sheet Name/Username/e-mail all read "Kessling"; the live DS page and player page use "Mike Kessler" — same player (small-world rule), spelling question for Bill

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Username:''' Kessling
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
